display_long_description:
# 🐻 Protect your owner!

Step into the paws of a teddy bear and fight to protect your owner from waves of nightmares invading her dreams. Armed with homemade weapons and defenses, you'll battle through twisted dream worlds in an action-packed VR shooter that blends frantic combat with strategic survival.
[media]

# 🐻 Play solo or with friends

Face the nightmares alone or team up online with up to 4 players. Coordinate your defenses, revive fallen teammates, and survive increasingly overwhelming enemy attacks together.
[media]

# 🐻 Survive the nightmare

Battle through six unique dream-inspired maps as you face everything from garden gnomes and rubber ducks to skeletons and shadow monsters. Complete ten escalating waves to conquer each night, or jump into Endless Mode and see how long you can survive.
[media]

# 🐻 Fight with homemade weapons

Blast enemies with an arsenal built from everyday household objects, dual-wield your favorites, physically reload in VR, and upgrade your firepower at the weapon station.
[media]

# 🐻 Build the perfect defense

Construct barricades, traps, and manual turrets to hold back the nightmare hordes. Upgrade and repair damaged defenses, reinforce your position, and prepare before the next wave begins.
[media]

# 🐻 Make your teddy truly yours

Level up your teddy and unlock outfit and fur customizations to create your own unique Two Foot Hero. Master your favorite weapons to unlock exclusive skins.
[media]
